package.description: Liberica JDK is a free and open source Java Development Kit produced by BellSoft.

en-US.description: Liberica JDK is a free and open source Java Development Kit produced by BellSoft.
en-US.longDescription: Liberica JDK is available on a variety of platforms. It is built from OpenJDK which BellSoft contributes to and is thoroughly tested. Liberica JDK is compatible with the Java SE standard as confirmed by the JCK provided under the license from OpenJDK. Support options are available from BellSoft.
en-US.name: Liberica JDK 17 Lite
